results.title: Mahama’s GH¢10m media fund commitment wins bipartisan backing – Bunkpurugu MP
results.content: President John Mahama's decision to allocate GH¢10 million as seed money for the Media Development Fund has received support from both sides of Parliament, with the MP for Bunkpurugu, Dr Abednego Lamangin Bandim, describing it as a significant commitment to the development of Ghana’s media industry.

results.title: UG students reject hostel fee hikes as EFL raises academic freedom concerns
results.content: The Economic Fighters League (EFL) has thrown its support behind students of the University of Ghana who staged a demonstration against increased hostel accommodation charges, describing the protest as a broader struggle to protect academic freedom and the right of students to organise and challenge university authorities.

results.title: New Economy raises questions over delivery of 24-hour economy – IPPA
results.content: The Institute of Public Policy and Accountability (IPPA) has questioned the government's proposed $10 billion New Economy programme, demanding clarity on how it differs from the 24-Hour Economy initiative announced earlier as a major driver of job creation and economic transformation. In a press statement signed by the Executive Director of the Institute ahead of the 2027 Budget Statement, the Institute said Ghanaians needed explanations about the new programme, particularly when several flagship interventions announced in the 2026 Budget had yet to demonstrate tangible results.

results.title: Nvidia, CEO Huang sued over disclosures related to suspected Chinese spy
results.content: Nvidia and Chief Executive Jensen Huang were sued on Monday in a proposed class action accusing them of defrauding shareholders by concealing Huang's ties to a suspected Chinese spy.

results.title: Media houses must have accountability systems to receive grants – George Sarpong
results.content: Media houses seeking grants from the Media Development Fund must have accountability systems, the Executive Secretary of the National Media Commission (NMC), George Sarpong, said.

results.title: Global Changemakers Conference 2026: Build Beyond Africa set to inspire young people to drive change
results.content: With just a week to go, preparations are underway for the 2026 Global Changemakers Conference, which seeks to inspire young people to recognise their potential, embrace purposeful leadership and take an active role in driving positive change in their communities and beyond.

results.title: We should avoid creating a big bureaucracy around Media Development Fund – George Sarpong
results.content: The Chairman of Parliament’s Select Committee on Information and Communications, Dr Abednego Lamangin Bandim, has urged a lean management structure for the Media Development Fund.

results.title: Ken Ashigbey rejoins Kofi Bentil’s Facebook post on Gold Fields
results.content: Kofi Bentil, my brother, I have responded to the issues you raised, but let me reiterate a few important points. We must be careful not to present selective information in a manner that creates a misleading impression. First, on the US$30,000 purportedly paid for the mining lease. Ghana has historically used standard mining lease agreements, and Gold Fields' lease was not materially different from those issued to other mining companies at the time. The consideration provision in the lease must therefore be understood within that context. It is misleading to isolate the US$30,000 figure and present it as the total amount Gold Fields paid to acquire and maintain its mining rights.

results.title: Turkey steel factory blast kills at least 17 people
results.content: At least 17 people have died, and 12 others have been injured in an explosion at an iron and steel factory near the port city of Izmir in western Turkey.

results.title: Trump says FBI investigating Nvidia boss’s affair with alleged Chinese spy

results.title: Farouk Aliu Mahama confirms 2028 Yendi parliamentary bid
results.content: Former Member of Parliament for Yendi, Dr Farouk Aliu Mahama, has confirmed his intention to contest the constituency's parliamentary seat in the 2028 general election on the ticket of the New Patriotic Party (NPP). His decision follows what his supporters describe as weeks of appeals from youth groups, traditional leaders, elders and other community stakeholders urging him to return to active parliamentary politics.

results.content: Ghana possesses an economic advantage that many countries would spend fortunes attempting to manufacture: an internationally recognised cultural identity, remarkable historical assets and a growing tourism market.

results.title: 63 countries eliminate at least one neglected tropical disease as WHO reports global progress
results.content: The number of countries that have eliminated at least one neglected tropical disease (NTD) has increased to 63, up from 42 at the end of 2020, according to the World Health Organisation (WHO). The development represents significant progress in global efforts to control and eliminate diseases that disproportionately affect the world’s poorest and most vulnerable […]
